'''The Tangles''' were an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] located within the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA" />
